decisions.reason: The added logos and colour codes change the separate asset-package requirement; the candidate already has a same-message MODIFY covering Canva, Word, and PDF format requirements.
Adding asset types to the handoff package does not change which customer-specific report fields must be editable.
The asset-package expansion does not change the required style, content, or coverage of internal-page headers.
Including logos and colour codes in the asset package does not alter any version-specific report identifier rule.
The source decision concerns reusable handoff assets and leaves footer presentation and page coverage unchanged.
The required asset types do not change the dashboard's fields, score presentation, or communication goal.
The asset-package change does not modify the content or scannable presentation of the front-page result explanation.
Delivery of additional reusable assets supports future editing but does not change the report's accepted visual style or refinement priorities.
The added handoff assets do not alter the mapping between report variants and exposure bands.
The source decision does not change the warning's presence, visual treatment, message, or footer-interference constraint.
The asset-package expansion has no effect on risk-profile-specific report wording.
